label: Cricket

criteria.label: Arm extension through contact
criteria.look_for: arms extend through the ball, bat face under control
criteria.drill: Shadow drives to a cone, finish with the bat high and extended.
criteria.implementation_note: Lead-elbow extension is a proxy for bat execution; the bat itself is not tracked.

criteria.label: Base and knee bend
criteria.look_for: stable base, front knee bending into the shot
criteria.drill: Front-foot drives with a pause at contact.
criteria.implementation_note: Single-window image-plane knee angle, not a support-knee trajectory.

criteria.label: Head over the ball
criteria.look_for: head still and over the ball, body leaning into the shot
criteria.drill: Throwdowns with the head held still until after contact.
criteria.implementation_note: Image-plane trunk lean, not a calibrated 3D inclination.

criteria.label: Hip position
criteria.look_for: hips rotating through, weight transferring forward
criteria.drill: Weight-transfer drills stepping into the shot.
criteria.implementation_note: Image-plane hip angle, not a 3D pelvis/shoulder rotation.

camera_angles.label: Side view
camera_angles.description: Camera at 90 degrees to the action. Best for arm extension and lean.

camera_angles.label: Front view
camera_angles.description: Camera facing the athlete. Best for balance and knee alignment.

coaching_note: Judge the batting shot: stance, head position, weight transfer, follow-through.
scope_note: Research scope is the front-foot off-drive only. The pack's other event types are product-only and are not part of the research protocol until separately configured and validated.

phases.label: Preparation
phases.definition: Stance and initial bat lift before forward movement.

phases.label: Forward movement
phases.definition: Front foot travels toward the pitch of the ball.

phases.label: Front-foot support
phases.definition: Front foot plants and the base is established.

phases.label: Bat execution
phases.definition: Bat is swung through the intended off-side line.

phases.label: Impact interval
phases.definition: Bat-ball contact when observable at the native frame rate.

phases.label: Recovery
phases.definition: Post-stroke balance and return to a stable position.
